title: MCP tool removal candidates (review 2026-06-17)
summary:
6 tools recommended for removal based on analytics (2026-06-10 to 2026-06-11, 70 calls across 29 tools). Review week of 2026-06-17 before acting.

REMOVE candidates:
1. attach_knowledge — superseded by record_decision in practice; never reached for
2. list_agents — get_full_graph assignees cover the use case; agent collision never occurred
3. loop_control — orch-loop skill never calls it; next_action is the actual loop driver
4. request_agent_stop — advisory-only, scenario never occurred; CAS in start_task is the real guard
5. set_status — its own description says prefer start_task/complete_task; never used
6. supersede_note — fully redundant with record_decision supersedes param

All other zero-call tools are either dormant-but-load-bearing (metric loop: branch_task, configure_task, measure_task) or fire-rarely-by-design (list_guidance, request_guidance, supersede_task). Do not remove those.
